S1.rationale: Agent Laboratory's researcher, experimenter and writing actors execute literature, code, experiment and manuscript tasks in a shared phase workflow. Although user issue #103 reports blank manuscript sections, no verified current-code root cause or contract-based S1 fix has yet emerged from this bounded check.

S2.rationale: Sequenced research phases and role-dialogue handoffs exchange artifacts but do not show distinct viable operating divisions interfering and receiving anti-oscillation coordination. A missing section in final text is not evidence of an S2 concurrency defect.

S3.rationale: A scripted LaboratoryWorkflow and per-phase retry/step limits regulate sequential runs, not a discretion-owning organization-wide manager. The product does not demonstrate demand for a new centralized project-portfolio controller in its frozen review.

S3*.rationale: The project has separately prompted reviewer judgments, but the standard correction/re-entry path after criticism remains ambiguous. Issue #103 about missing paper sections could involve writing-stage context, reviewer logic or prompts and cannot be blamed on S3* without an independent reproduction.

S4.rationale: PhD/postdoc literature search and research plan synthesis provide an actual future-facing adaptation of the experiment, with optional human Co-Pilot parent decisions (A(P)). No concrete defect in that research agenda planning flow is established by the assessment.

S5.rationale: Topic choice, compute limits, experimental resources and Co-Pilot approvals remain operator-owned inputs; there is no separate authoritative policy/identity dispute return that would justify autonomizing mission choices.
